summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 2, 2026, furnishing a press release that reports high-grade silver exploration drill results from its Zgounder Silver Mine in Morocco. The release highlights multiple drill intersections with significant silver grades, such as 1,867 g/t Ag over 6.0 meters in hole ZG-RC-26-946, but does not involve any transaction, strategic change, or corporate event. It is a routine operational update on exploration progress, with 30.8% of the 2026 program drilled year-to-date. No special situation category applies.
